description.text: We bring people, knowledge, and capital together: for founders, established companies, students, researchers, and professionals.

targetApplicants.text: Great ideas need the right foundation. UnternehmerTUM builds it. As Europe’s leading center for innovation and business creation, we bring people, knowledge, and capital together. We support founders from first idea to scale. We drive innovation in established companies, SMEs, and family businesses, and help secure their future, including through succession. We help students, researchers, and professionals turn their own ideas into successful businesses.
